diagnosis: Round 3 scan of the core user task flows found three issues: (1) The loading spinner text says '6 regions' but the calculator actually computes 8 regions (US/UK/EU/FR/AU/NZ/India/Canada), creating a trust gap — users who notice the discrepancy question accuracy. (2) The compare sister-sizes card description lacks an id attribute (id='size-choice-compare-desc') so the JavaScript that dynamically updates it with the user's actual sister sizes (e.g. 'See 32DD / 34D / 36C side-by-side') silently fails — users always see the generic placeholder text. (3) The #size-next-steps element referenced in bra-calculator-main.js fillAll() does not exist in the HTML, so the 2.2s delayed reveal animation is a no-op dead code; this is harmless but indicates incomplete feature wiring between the two JS files.
